name: US straight-wall tote 15.75 x 11.75 x 8.25 in
description:
A US straight-wall stacking container, 15.75 x 11.75 x 8.25 in (400 x 298 x 210 mm), modelled on the Akro-Mils 37288 solid-wall tote from the Akro-Mils straight- wall catalogue. It is the half-footprint member of the US range (nominal 16 x 12 in), the American counterpart of the 400 x 300 mm euro half module.

External dimensions: length 400 mm, width 298 mm, height 210 mm.

US catalogue equivalent of the 600 x 400 euro module: nominal 24 x 16 in (and its 16 x 12 half), which is 600 x 400 mm in practice.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 4,532 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
summary: US straight-wall tote, 15.75 x 11.75 x 8.25 in (400 x 298 x 210 mm) - true-scale GLB of the Akro-Mils 37288 solid-wall stacking container.
